primary_sources.title: τ-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains

primary_sources.selection_reason: latest visible official ancestor preceding the paper v1 submission
primary_sources.certainty: exact inspected revision; historical-run linkage not established

benchmark.task_split: paper reports complete benchmark suites; paper-era source maps task_split=test to tasks.py
benchmark.split_caveat: Retail has distinct train/dev files in the paper-era source; airline exposes only test in the inspected revision. The paper reports benchmark suites, not an independent random train/test sampling procedure for these results.

experiment_inventory.purpose: sort tasks by difficulty and inspect zero/low success tasks during task annotation

paper_method.environment: tool-agent-user interaction; actor sees policy/tools; user simulator receives task instruction; reward checks final database state and required information in agent responses
paper_method.main_method: zero-shot function calling; FC chooses either a user response or a tool call; compared with text ReAct and Act-only
paper_method.user_simulator_note: Single simulator profile is described; the reported cost breakdown is not a user-model comparison.
paper_method.sampling: paper describes i.i.d. stochastic trials from user and agent language-model sampling; exact per-episode seeds and raw logs are not supplied
paper_method.pass_k_definition: For each task with n trials and c successes, task estimate is binom(c,k)/binom(n,k); pass^k is the average across tasks. pass@k is 1 minus average binom(n-c,k)/binom(n,k). pass^1 is mean reward.

source_discrepancies_and_limitations.finding: paper Table 2 requires at least 3 trials/task; paper-era run.py defaults --num_trials to 1
source_discrepancies_and_limitations.effect: running documented defaults does not reproduce the main-results protocol

source_discrepancies_and_limitations.finding: paper §3 names gpt-4-0613; paper-era run.py and user loader default to alias gpt-4
source_discrepancies_and_limitations.effect: default source config does not prove exact simulator snapshot used for paper results
source_discrepancies_and_limitations.certainty: high for discrepancy; historical run resolution unknown

source_discrepancies_and_limitations.finding: paper lists model names/providers but generally not dated immutable model snapshots; code offers multiple dated candidates and aliases without mapping each published table row to one exact ID
source_discrepancies_and_limitations.effect: current aliases cannot be assumed to reproduce historical model behavior

source_discrepancies_and_limitations.finding: paper does not publish per-episode seeds, exact n per task, or raw run manifests; code's default Python random seed controls ordering but does not fix hosted model sampling
source_discrepancies_and_limitations.effect: stochastic run records cannot be exactly replayed from public paper/source alone

source_discrepancies_and_limitations.finding: paper says 4 of 40 initial failures were instruction typo/ambiguity and then fixed; published artifacts do not preserve those four pre-fix task versions and complete labels
source_discrepancies_and_limitations.effect: exact reproduction of the original 115-trajectory failure classification is blocked

source_discrepancies_and_limitations.finding: gpt-4-32k profile is no longer callable from its original provider as a historic service snapshot
source_discrepancies_and_limitations.effect: exact historical replication of that model profile is not presently available via the original service
source_discrepancies_and_limitations.certainty: high as of 2025-06-06 provider shutoff reported by parent; current availability is not inferred for other providers

source_discrepancies_and_limitations.finding: 6f4b718 is the nearest visible pre-submission author revision, not a proven executed-paper snapshot; 59a200c is a materially later comparator with 113 tracked files and changes across run, agent, environment, task and user code
source_discrepancies_and_limitations.effect: the later tree cannot silently replace the paper-era tree or be treated as the v1 benchmark state
source_discrepancies_and_limitations.certainty: high from local manifests and git diff

source_discrepancies_and_limitations.finding: the local study's v4 contains four episodes on one exposed airline test task, zero complete paired trials, and is explicitly developmental; the proposed 1,320 episode gate grid is a separate two-arm/four-repeat local extension
source_discrepancies_and_limitations.effect: neither local result is evidence of full paper reproduction or paper-wide gate effect
source_discrepancies_and_limitations.certainty: high from docs/POST_V4_FINDINGS.md and frozen local plans

reproduction_verdict.reason: No new paid/model episodes were run; historic model snapshots and run-level sample records are unavailable; the existing local study has a different intervention, profile, task sample, and incomplete paired results.
